hints.title: Functional Graph Structure
hints.text: Each person has exactly one outgoing edge, decomposing the graph into cycles with directed inbound trees.

hints.title: Cycle Length Disparity
hints.text: A cycle of length 3 or more must stand alone, while multiple cycles of length 2 can seat guests with their incoming chains.

hints.title: Dual Case Maximization
hints.text: Return the maximum of the largest isolated cycle length and the aggregate sum across all 2-cycle arm configurations.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N) functional graph cycle detection and arm tracking
complexity.space: O(N) in-degree and max chain depth arrays
complexity.notes: Compare the largest cycle of length >= 3 against the sum of all 2-cycles with their longest inbound arms.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Assuming a single cycle must seat all guests ignores that multiple 2-cycles with arms can coexist.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Kahn topological reduction prunes chains and calculates max depth before cycle inspection.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should separate the problem into length >= 3 cycles and sum of length 2 cycles with arms.
